opening.argument: The video directs viewers toward registration, package upgrades, and paid tiers that allocate tokens or points, including an offer of 1,000 tokens for EUR 100. It presents these packages as connected to token doubling and to receiving a coin after performing later mining, making those returns part of the expected package outcome. The instructions to “Click here on UPGRADE” reinforce that viewers are being guided toward a paid commitment. At the same time, the dashboard shows zero displayed balances, and the available evidence does not establish that payment, delivery, or any later outcome occurred.

citations.quote: for EUR 100 a package you will receive 1 000 TOKENS
with the 1.000 package. Then you do the mining again and you get one coin for it.
